changelog: More reliable notifications with improved device registration and retry handling.
Improved referral information handling in OPD Booking and OPD Update.
More reliable follow-up synchronization that adapts to the doctor’s schedule and active city.
Improved app update installation and verification.
Refined location prompts, notification-card layout, and follow-up age display.
Ambajogai EEG Calls now support mandatory mobile numbers for booking and updates, with numbers shown in statistics and patient details.
